name: y-sync-package
description: Y server and client for syncing Yjs documents over WebRTC
author: bcibi

scripts.version-deps: find . -name package.json -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -exec sed -Ei "s#(\"@bcibibi/.*\": *\")\^[^\"]*#\1^$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')#g" {} \;
scripts.version-patch: npm version patch --workspaces && npm run version-deps
